summary_en: 70,000 shares, ¥100M upper limit, 3.35% of shares outstanding (ex-treasury). Acquisition period 12 Aug 2026–31 Jul 2027. Method: open-market purchase on ToSTNeT-3. Stated purpose: strategic capital allocation, M&A deployment, and execution of near-term investment aligned with ¥10B sales target by Sep 2030.
